papers_found.title: Extracting the Structure of Press Releases for Predicting Earnings Announcement Returns
papers_found.relevance_reason: Directly validates H163/H174: FinBERT = best NLP method on 138k press releases 2005-2023. Soft info as informative as EPS surprise. Model combination (FinBERT + LDA) improves R². Actionable H227 design path.
papers_found.note: Market efficiency finding (day-0 announcement return fully absorbed at open) does NOT contradict our 20-day PEAD drift strategy
